versions.content: If it is possible to buffer a CanIf Tx L-PDU or a Transmit Request , because the buffer size of the assigned CanIfTxBuffer is bigger than zero (see [SWS_CANIF_00835]), CanIf shall overwrite direct transmitted CanIf Tx L-PDU in the assigned CanIfTxBuffer , if the CanIf Tx L-PDU is already buffered in the CanIfTxBuffer when Can_Write() returns CAN_BUSY .
